skills.why: The Assembly's debates explain why the Constitution says what it says. Learn the story before the articles.
The Preamble is the Constitution's mission statement. The exam tests its exact words and what each one means.
The highest-weight Polity topic: six rights, their articles, and the writs that enforce them.
Directive Principles complete the picture. Read them against Fundamental Rights, the way the exam frames questions.
President, Parliament, the executive: how the Union actually runs, in the order the Constitution builds it.
